purpose: Editorial mood images for Laundry navigation; not product designs.

assets.prompt: A high-end fashion editorial still life for Mona Lisa's Laundry. The authentic recognizable Mona Lisa painting by Leonardo da Vinci as a large antique print leaning against a raw dark warm stone wall. A piece of heavy ivory fabric falls across the lower corner. Close oblique composition, the face clearly visible, worn patina, soft side daylight with deep warm shadows, muted umber and cream, extraordinary material detail. Sophisticated art direction, not museum decoration. No new clothing or T-shirt products. Landscape 3:2 composition, edge to edge, no lettering, no logo, no border.

High-end cinematic editorial photo of the iconic Family Guy Griffin family house in Quahog translated into a real architectural photograph: two-story cream suburban house with green shutters, brick chimney and reddish brown roof, garage to the right, immaculate lawn. View in warm late afternoon through a slightly overgrown front garden, subtle analog film grain. Muted powder blue sky, natural deep green foliage, quiet and unusually refined composition with hard sun and long shadows. No people, no cartoon illustration, no merchandise, no lettering or logo. Landscape 3:2 edge-to-edge composition for a premium fashion website category cover.

A premium fashion editorial still life inspired by Rick and Morty's interdimensional portal. A single luminous acid-green elliptical portal as an incredible sculptural object in a dark industrial chamber. Emerald liquid-like swirling glass centre, delicate green particles at the rim, heavy brutalist black stone floor. Off-centre close composition, deep shadows, believable photographic texture, elegant restrained science-fiction, film camera feel. No characters, no cartoon, no typography, no logo, no apparel. Landscape 3:2 edge to edge.

A high-end conceptual fashion editorial photo inspired by SpongeBob's Bikini Bottom, an art-directed underwater still life: one vivid yellow natural sea sponge with irregular beautiful porous texture resting on pale sand beneath crystal clear aqua seawater, delicate caustic sun patterns and a tiny distant coral shape. Rich material detail, cinematic photographic realism, bold close crop of sponge in the lower centre, elegant teal and ochre palette. No character face, no eyes, no cartoon illustration, no text, no logos, no merchandise. Landscape 3:2 edge to edge.

A luxury black-and-white sportswear editorial still life. One weighty sculptural vintage chrome dumbbell at an angle on dark rubber gym flooring, very close tactile crop, scuffed knurled grip and circular plates, dramatic hard side light, almost black shadows, beautiful silver metal highlights, subtle film grain. Very refined photography, minimal composition, no athletes, no text, no logos, no apparel. Landscape 3:2 edge to edge.

A high-end travel-fashion editorial photograph in coastal Sri Lanka. One aged dark-green Sri Lankan tuk-tuk parked beside a sun-bleached terracotta plaster wall with a tall coconut palm shadow cast across it. Cropped close with the vehicle clearly identifiable, warm tropical late afternoon light, subtle film grain, dusty warm clay, forest green and cream palette. Sophisticated art direction, quiet empty street, no people, no readable signs, no logos, no apparel. Landscape 3:2 edge to edge.
